palette.notes: Frames (clip 2): warm brown wood interior, orange curtains, red-haired hero and mother in red/blue; airship sky in peach, pink and cream with dark teal-brown ships. Shadows go to dark warm brown, not black.

lighting: Soft daylight from a window lights the room; wood planks get a lighter top edge and a dark brown gap line. Sky scene uses bands of warm haze fading to cream near the horizon.
silhouette: Small 3/4 top-down chibi sprites (about 2.5 heads tall) with big hair as the identity shape: red spiky hair for Glenn, long red hair for the mother; a blue lizard-like crew member. Close-up portraits carry the face in dialogue.

motion.timing: No frame timings measured. Clip 2: the mother walks down from the window to the bed over ~15 s of dialogue, then stands next to the hero; the hero mostly holds still while text plays.

texture: Clean 16-bit tiles: wood plank floors and barrels with 2-3 value steps, banded dithered clouds in the sky; no noise. Wiki: art inspired by the 16-bit era, modern and nostalgic.
camera: Fixed 3/4 top-down room view, held still during dialogue; airship scene is a side view with parallax cloud bands. Dialogue boxes top and bottom with a hand-drawn portrait.
sound: Eddie Marianukroh score, 50 tracks over about two hours (wiki).

acting.enters: Mother enters the hero's space by walking across the room toward him while she talks (clip 2, 1.7-19 s).
acting.acts: Comedy in staging: she nags in text, the sleepy hero answers with a portrait close-up, then she walks right next to him for the punchline line.
acting.exits: Cut to a title card and a wide airship shot, then a new room with a new character.
acting.depth: Small sprites in a wide room; the portrait close-up gives the near shot. Airship scene: ships small in the distance in hazy sky.

techniques: walk-closer staging: speaker moves toward the listener as the line escalates
portrait close-up cut-in for the reaction, sprite stays small
warm brown ramps, shadows to deep warm brown
big hair as the character identity shape at small size
banded haze sky with layered ship silhouettes
enemies and fights on the same screen as exploration (wiki)
feel: warm wood room + small chibi sprites + portrait reaction cut-ins + walk-closer staging = cozy JRPG comedy
for_fred: Stage Pixie's nag like this: Fred stays small and still, Pixie walks closer in two or three steps on each line, then cut to a big Fred reaction face for one beat. Distance closing = escalation, no extra animation needed.
